label: row_0
context: This table extends the same study used in steric_sn2, but focuses on the effect of π conjugation on SN2 reactivity. Primary, non-conjugated bromides (ethyl, n-propyl) define the baseline, whereas allyl and benzyl bromides react tens-to-hundreds-fold faster because resonance delocalizes negative charge developed in the SN2 transition state into the adjacent π system.
